jsonld_raw.name: (220 G) SPICY SANDALWOOD SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Spicy Sandalwood | An intense opening of black pepper and incense, evoking ancient places and traditional Polish markets. The floral and solar heart illuminates the richness of sandalwood with a sophisticated contrast. Warm and sensual base of vanilla, tonka, patchouli and musk.

Notes:
Top notes: black pepper, incense, cherry
Heart notes: solar accord, white flowers, sandalwood
Base notes: vanilla bean, tonka bean, patchouli, musk
